description: USD/JPY tick-level (bid/ask) windows around scheduled macro events (NFP, CPI, FOMC, BOJ), one file per event date, used for event-response backtests. Split across two owner-downloaded snapshot directories by coverage era.
source: owner-downloaded tick history windowed around each event's scheduled release time (see MISSING.txt / manifest.json in each snapshot directory for exact fetch provenance and any dates that could not be obtained). data/fx/events/ and data/fx/calendar.csv are the live working copy the two backtest_data/fx_event_ticks_* snapshots were cut from -- identical column shapes (verified: header is 'ts_utc,bid,ask,bidvol,askvol' for every event file, 'date,time_utc,type,source,confidence,note' for calendar.csv, matching the file_groups below).
retention: permanent owner-downloaded snapshot (backtest_data/fx_event_ticks_2005_2014 and _2015_2026 split by coverage era); never re-scraped in place. data/fx/events/ and data/fx/calendar.csv are the working copy (kept indefinitely, not itself dated/frozen) -- data/fx/events/manifest.json documents per-event fetch status and data/fx/calendar_cache*/ hold the raw scraped HTML pages behind each calendar entry (both non-tabular, out of scope for this schema).

type.meaning: event code, matches the per-event filename prefix (NFP/CPI/FOMC/BOJ)

confidence.meaning: owner's confidence in the scheduled time

known_defects: data/fx/events/ (working copy) is not itself frozen -- if this directory is ever re-scraped in place, the backtest_data/fx_event_ticks_2005_2014 and _2015_2026 dated snapshots are the reproducible reference, not this copy
coverage is split across two directories by era (2005-2014, 2015-2026) with BOJ only present from 2015 onward -- do not assume BOJ events exist pre-2015

fx_event_ticks_2005_2014/MISSING.txt records event dates the owner could not obtain a tick file for -- an event listed in calendar.csv with no corresponding *_YYYYMMDD.csv.gz is a known, documented gap, not a silent collection failure
ts_utc is epoch milliseconds, not an ISO string like most other datasets in this repo -- do not assume string sorting or a bare int() cast without unit conversion
